retrievalProfile.description: A multi-layered composition featuring a group in coordinated androgynous 90s fashion with high-contrast, oversized typography and warm, sun-drenched outdoor lighting.

recipe.visualDefinition: A group portrait of four individuals in 90s-era menswear-inspired clothing, set against a soft-focus natural background, anchored by large, vibrant green typography that overlaps the subjects.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm, earthy background tones vs. vibrant neon-green foreground text
Subject poses ranging from seated to standing to create a triangular group dynamic
Oversized display type acting as a physical barrier/foreground element
Coordinated fashion palette of black, white, and orange against natural greens/browns
coreInvariants: High-contrast, heavy-weight display typography in the lower third
Warm, slightly desaturated photographic color grading
Androgynous styling including vests, ties, and newsboy caps

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four subjects arranged in a staggered formation; one seated bottom left, three standing across the mid-ground.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bright green 'EX' text in the lower center-right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left logo, moves down the standing figures, and settles on the large green text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with subjects and large-scale typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm earth tones (tan, brown, muted orange) in the background and clothing.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black and crisp white in the vests and shirts.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant lime green for the primary display text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the typography against a medium-saturation, warm-toned photograph.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain a warm, golden-hour light quality

letterConstructionRules: Extreme weight in the main display characters
Tight letter spacing with intentional overlaps
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'g' and 'f' in the sub-text use gothic/blackletter flourishes
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a geometric slab serif with a decorative gothic blackletter.
graphicDevices: Stylized 'X' logo in the top left corner
Vertical stacked text for secondary metadata

preserve: The heavy weight of the main text
The blackletter style for the secondary text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serif structure of the main display text.
Approximates the gothic blackletter style of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a group portrait of four women in 90s androgynous fashion (vests, ties, newsboy caps) in a warm, sunlit outdoor park setting with soft-focus trees.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add oversized lime green text in the lower third using a heavy slab serif for the top line and a blackletter font for the bottom line, ensuring the text overlaps the subjects' legs.

verificationChecks: Is the main text lime green?
Is the lighting warm and golden?
Does the text overlap the subjects?

adjustableVariables: Specific fashion items (e.g., changing caps to berets)
mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the original subjects
postGenerationChecks: Check that the green text is the most saturated element.
Ensure the background has a soft, natural bokeh.
Verify the fashion looks period-accurate to the early 90s.
Confirm the typography is legible despite the heavy weight.
recipe.reuseFormula: 90s R&B Group Portrait + Warm Outdoor Lighting + Heavy Slab/Blackletter Typography Overlay
